title: Square Invoices: Invoice Maker
summary: Manage your business invoicing, bills & estimates. Track expenses & payments.
description:
The free Square Invoices app is your go-to invoice maker that lets you get paid from anywhere. With the app, you can easily send bills and estimates, track payment status, set auto-reminders for upcoming invoices, monitor your cash flow, and manage your finances. There are no monthly fees or commitments.

ANY BUSINESS Whether you’re a small business, contractor, or freelancer, it's easy to create and send your customers estimates for a job and request deposits quickly. Our templates will help guide you through the invoicing and receipt process. It’s an essential invoicing solution that supports any business:
► Home & Repair: Contractors, Landscaping, Cleaning, Plumbing
► Food & Drink: Catering, Bakeries, Wholesale Stores
► Professional Services: Web Designers, Photographers, Consultants, Accountants

All the tools you need to run your business from one place.
► Estimates, invoices, contracts, receipts, and bills with just a few taps
► Create and send professional invoices from simple templates.
► Customize estimates and invoices with logos, line items, attachments, messages, and color schemes
► Accept any payment: credit and debit cards, Google Pay, cash, check, or ACH payment.
► Send invoices wherever your customers prefer—email, URL, or text message
► Track online invoice status: viewed, paid, unpaid, or overdue.
► Save time with auto-reminders, or set up recurring billing and keep debit or credit cards on file
► Set taxes automatically apply when you add items to your invo
